title: Arian Paradoxes and Omissions
english: But the paradoxical partisans of Arius declare that Christ has been made to commit sin.
As for the fact that God was reconciling the world to himself in Christ (2 Cor 5:19), they neither carry it in their memory nor with the organs of speech.
translator_notes: True OET; Pass A ≠ Pass B. Melito skipped; never Cyril Matthew densify.

title: The Malice of Accusers
english: They shout out. But just as wicked informers and accusers, having distorted the field, perform the contest of accusation, it is necessary to include all the lawful combatants without fail in a love of truth, but not toward deceit, some being silenced and others being torn away.
translator_notes: True OET; Pass A ≠ Pass B. Melito skipped; never Cyril Matthew densify.

title: Distinction between Created and Begotten
english: To bring forth. For if [it] is a creature, then it is not begotten; but if [it] is begotten, it is not a creature; since neither [can] the nature turn toward the same [thing] in either way. Everything having a beginning receives an end, and everything receiving an end is subject to decay.
translator_notes: True OET; Pass A ≠ Pass B. Melito skipped; never Cyril Matthew densify.
